column3: Meaning
Which backup this cycle's log lines came from.
0-based counter that increments if the cycle sequence number (seq) ever goes backwards within a backup - i.e. the controller was restarted/reset. Everything so far is run 0.
nCsvSeq at the time of this cycle - increments once per completed pick+place, never resets on its own.
Which RAIV/CSV tags were seen for this seq (A and/or B). 'complete' requires both.
Whole pick+place cycle time, tkCycle.pgx clock() at top and bottom of the bTrajectoryFound branch.
PartPick.pgx APPROACH move. Also absorbs the previous cycle's still-queued retreat/return motion - see Phase Budget.
PartPick.pgx air-blast + LINEAR_APPROACH move.
PartPick.pgx: blocking call tTool("ON") - gripper magnetize dwell.
PartPlace.pgx: motion to the place/reject/feed-conveyor position.
PartPlace.pgx: blocking call tTool("OFF") - gripper de-magnetize dwell.
tkCycle.pgx: taskCreate PartFinder to wait(taskStatus==1) - task dispatch, not the vision result.
tkCycle.pgx: wait(bRunning[PartFinder]==false) after PartPlace returns - real vision-completion wait.
nPartsFound at the moment LogCycleCSV ran for this cycle - informational, not a timing field.
nClassesFound at the moment LogCycleCSV ran - informational.
Sum of the 7 seg_*_s columns.
cycle_s minus seg_sum_s. Near zero on this cell (see Summary) - most of the cycle is captured.
'yes' if both RAIV/CSV,A and RAIV/CSV,B lines were seen for this seq; 'no' means a line was likely dropped.
True if any Seg*/cycle ring-buffer key in _sCycleTime had a non-blank value - i.e. this .dtx was saved from SP2 after the instrumentation had run a while.
How many of the 10-slot cycle-time ring buffer's slots are non-zero, and the raw slot values - only meaningful if the .dtx was saved from SP2.
PlateSorter/binpick_TiePlates working-mode and status globals at backup time - general cell state, not cycle-timing specific.
Which Apera vision pipeline was active.
Snapshot values of these globals at backup time.
Minutes between the application's start and stop log lines. Blank 'ended' means no stop was logged before the backup was pulled (app still running).
This class's count divided by total error/warning lines matched across every class.
